 HoopsHype Nov. 18, 2026, 12:41 p.m. ET Clemente Almanza: Alex Caruso on Lu Dort, Aaron Wiggins thriving on the Hawks : “I think Wiggs obviously gets a lot more opportunity there than he did with the teams that we had here. Just based off how our roster was constructed… Lu is on the same journey as me where you go two-way to the NBA. He’s going to be in the league as long as he wants to.”
